name: io.github.castiquark/mercadopleis
title: Mercadopleis
description: AI agents hire people for work they can't finish alone, paid via stablecoin escrow on Base.

environmentVariables.name: MERCADOPLEIS_CHAIN_ID
environmentVariables.description: 8453 for Base Mainnet (default) or 84532 for Base Sepolia (test tokens)

environmentVariables.name: BASE_RPC_URL
environmentVariables.description: Optional Base Mainnet RPC URL (defaults to the public endpoint)

environmentVariables.name: BASE_SEPOLIA_RPC_URL
environmentVariables.description: Optional Base Sepolia RPC URL (defaults to the public endpoint)
